note: Phone agent settings (S2; calls routed through Doddy's server since ADR-490). Doddy's server lets a call through and passes these variables with ElevenLabs register-call (server/messaging/src/routes/twilioVoice.ts); the placeholders below are only for tests in the ElevenLabs dashboard.

variables.doddy_call_opening: The first sentence, set by the server and never by the model, always saying Doddy is an AI (DOD-03): "Hi, this is Doddy, an AI assistant. How can I help?", or on a scheduled call "...You asked me to call you about this: <reason>" (in Polish when the call was asked for in Polish)
variables.doddy_call_reason: none | the reason the user approved for a scheduled call (ADR-495), their own words

secret_variables.secret__doddy_session: Per-call session id; only ever placed in tool headers, never shown to the model

placeholders.doddy_call_opening: Hi, this is Doddy, an AI assistant. How can I help?

workspace_secrets.doddy_tool_secret: ELEVENLABS_TOOL_SECRET (same value as on the server)

privacy.note: Calls can contain memories read aloud (ADR-158)
